title: Module 2: Fairness Definitions and Their Impossibilities
description: Compare demographic parity, equalized odds, calibration within groups, individual fairness, and counterfactual fairness, and reason about the impossibility theorem that links them when base rates differ.
learning_objectives: State demographic parity, equalized odds, and calibration within groups in plain language and in formal notation.
Explain the Chouldechova / Kleinberg-Mullainathan-Raghavan impossibility result for unequal base rates.
Match a fairness criterion to a deployment context based on which kind of error causes the larger concrete harm.
Document a defensible fairness choice including the criteria not satisfied and the rationale.
